plan: chain plan v4: a learned 'who has the ball' at the labelled actions, against simple rules, leaving one match out
date: 2026-11-06, after link_variants.json; before any computation below
known before: chain.json: end to end 0.345 (nearest player to our linked ball, no answer without it); link_variants.json: linking variants +0.008; reading_sel_split.json: the near ball's candidates are weak (median confidence 0.07)
per action, the choices: our player rows at the action's even frame f (metric_v3s_link, cls player)
label: the detection matched to the actor by eval_soccertrack_v2.match_feet (image feet, 43 px) at f; actions without a matched actor are not trained on but are scored
features per player (fixed before any fi: distance to our linked ball at the nearest linked frame within f +- 4 (NaN if none) and the player's rank by it
distance to the linked ball nearest in time within f +- 25 frames, and that time gap

raw candidates of v3s_rows within f +- 6 frames: max confidence within 1, 2 and 3 m of the player's feet; count with confidence >= 0.02 within 2 m; sum of confidence within 2 m; the player's rank by the max within 2 m
distance to the top-confidence candidate of the nearest candidate frame within f +- 4
speed (m/s) from the player's own track over f +- 4
players within 3 m; distance to the nearest player with another team label and with the same one
box height in pixels; whether the player has a team label; the number of players at f
model: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=15, random_state=0), no tuning; per action the player with the highest score

rules compared (same actions).B1 pipeline: the nearest player to our linked ball at the nearest linked frame within f +- 4 (no use of the action's position); no answer without one
rules compared (same actions).B2 pipeline + fallback: B1; without a linked ball within f +- 4, the nearest player to the linked ball nearest in time within f +- 25 frames
rules compared (same actions).B3 top candidate: the nearest player to the top-confidence raw candidate of the nearest candidate frame within f +- 4

primary: end to end (the chosen player's mapped team is the action's side; chain.py's team map), held out by leaving one match out; gain = the model minus the best of B1, B2, B3 (the best chosen on all 9 matches, which favours the rules); 95% bootstrap over matches (5,000, seed 0)
also reported: the actor chosen (identity) share; per action kind; per match
bar: gain >= 0.03 with the interval's lower bound > 0
note: B1 here does not use the action's position (chain S1 did): it is the pipeline's rule as it would run, so its share differs from chain.json's 0.345
